name: Dazzlebirds Products Import Export For WooCommerce
author: WP SmartStore

sections.description:
Proper product data management in WooCommerce should be simple, orderly, and dependable. Dazzlebirds Products Import Export for WooCommerce helps store owners, developers, and agencies import, export, migrate, and update product data through structured CSV files.

The plugin supports day-to-day WooCommerce workflows such as migrating products to a new store, updating large catalogs, uploading supplier product data, backing up products, and tracking product records with ease. It is similar to WooCommerce Store Exporter, with one main difference: it helps you remove unwanted products, categories, tags, reviews, images, variations, attributes, taxonomies, and other product details to keep your store catalog clean.

Dazzlebirds Products Import Export for WooCommerce lets you build products in bulk and import them into your WooCommerce store effortlessly, making WooCommerce product data management easier without complicating the process.

Key Features

  • Import WooCommerce products from CSV files.
  • Export WooCommerce products to CSV for backups, reports, bulk editing, and migration.
  • Import and export product categories to manage catalog structure easily.
  • Import and export product tags for better product organization.
  • Import and export product reviews to preserve customer feedback.
  • Map CSV columns with the correct WooCommerce product fields before import.
  • Import and export product images, attributes, variations, and taxonomies.
  • Save reusable import and export templates for future product imports and exports.
  • Process large product files in batches for smoother data handling.
  • View detailed execution logs for import and export activities.
  • Track previous imports and exports with history records.
  • Manage WooCommerce product data with better accuracy and less manual work.
  • Continue import and export product operations while the browser remains open.

You Can Export and Import the Following Product Data

A WooCommerce product is not just a title, price, and image. Each product may be associated with SKUs, descriptions, categories, tags, reviews, gallery images, attributes, variations, stock information, and classification data, all of which contribute to a useful, organized catalog. As stores get bigger, doing all this by hand becomes slow, repetitive, and easy to make mistakes in.

Dazzlebirds Products Import Export for WooCommerce gives store owners a cleaner way to manage product data when doing routine updates, backups, and store migration tasks. You can import and export products, categories, tags, reviews, images, attributes, variations, and taxonomies without rebuilding catalog records one by one.

This is especially useful for WooCommerce stores with larger catalogs or that change products more often. The plugin helps make product import and export more controlled, consistent, and easier to manage, whether you are moving products to another store, updating existing records, or keeping catalog data organized.

What Makes Dazzlebirds Products Import Export for WooCommerce Different?

Dazzlebirds Products Import Export for WooCommerce is designed for larger businesses that need to scale their operations and reliably manage the flow of WooCommerce product data. The plugin helps you structure your product-related workflows for everything from regular catalog maintenance to new store migration projects, keeping products, categories, tags, and reviews in sync as you work.

How Businesses Use This Plugin

  • WooCommerce product catalog migrations.
  • Bulk product imports and exports.
  • Product catalog backups and data recovery.
  • Large-scale product updates.
  • Category and tag restructuring projects.
  • Preserving customer reviews during store migrations.
  • Product data transfers between WooCommerce stores.
  • Managing seasonal catalog changes.
  • Agencies handling multiple WooCommerce websites.
  • Ongoing WooCommerce catalog maintenance.

Work Clean and Controlled Product Catalogue

Managing WooCommerce product data is more difficult with a larger catalog. All the products, categories, tags, reviews, images, attributes, variations, and taxonomies need to stay organized. Manual handling of these records can lead to delays in product updates, backups, and migration work.

Dazzlebirds Products Import Export for WooCommerce allows store owners, developers, and agencies to manage product data with structured import and export. It becomes easier to manage important catalog records, since you can import, export, migrate, and update WooCommerce product data.

The plugin also supports column mapping, batch processing, reusable templates, execution logs, and import/export history. These capabilities allow users to review previous actions, manage larger product files more easily, and reduce the manual effort required to manage product data.

If you need to import products, export products, back up your catalog, bulk edit, update categories, manage tags, transfer reviews, or migrate your store, this plugin will keep your WooCommerce workflow simple, orderly, and reliable.

In WooCommerce, Control the Catalog Details That Matter Most

In WooCommerce, product data is tied to many small things. Your product might need the correct category, tag, image, review, attribute, variation, taxonomy, SKU, stock details, and product fields to appear correctly in the store. Updating these details individually is time-consuming and difficult to verify.

Dazzlebirds Products Import Export for WooCommerce provides a more convenient way for store owners to handle those catalog details together. You can import and export products, including categories, tags, reviews, images, attributes, variations, and taxonomies, making it easier to manage important product information during updates, backups, and migrations.

The plugin also supports column mapping, reusable templates, batch processing, execution logs, and import/export history — helpful when you have to repeat the same type of product data work. Instead of re-entering the setup every time, you can keep the process consistent and review previous actions when necessary.

This makes product data management less fragmented for stores with expanding catalogs. It offers a more transparent workflow for product imports, exports, catalog updates, bulk editing, and store migration instead of manually editing products one by one.

What You Can Manage With This Plugin

  • Product Import — import WooCommerce product data into your store without creating each product manually.
  • Product Export — export product records for backups, reports, bulk editing, catalog review, or store migration.
  • Category Management — import and export product categories to keep the WooCommerce catalog structure organized.
  • Tag Management — manage product tags during import and export so products remain easier to group and filter.
  • Product Reviews — import and export product reviews to preserve customer feedback during catalog updates or migration.
  • Product Images — handle product image data as part of the product import and export workflow.
  • Attributes and Variations — manage product attributes and variations for stores that sell variable product types.
  • Taxonomies — import and export taxonomy-related product data to keep catalog information structured.
  • Column Mapping — match file columns with the correct WooCommerce product fields before import.
  • Large File Handling — process larger product files in batches for smoother product data management.
  • Reusable Templates — save import and export templates for future product data tasks.
  • Logs and History — review execution logs and track previous import and export activities.
  • Catalog Migration — move product, category, tag, review, image, attribute, variation, and taxonomy data between WooCommerce stores.
  • Bulk Product Updates — update large product catalogs with less manual work and better control over product records.

Product import and export

  • Export simple, variable, grouped, and external products with full attribute, variation, stock, image, tax, and metadata detail.
  • Import products that preserve product IDs, SKUs, parent/child variation links, attributes, gallery images, low-stock thresholds, and custom meta.
  • Filter exports by status, type, date range, category, tag, brand, stock status, and product ID list.

Product reviews

  • Export reviews including rating, content, author, verified-purchase flag, and approval state.
  • Import reviews back with product matching by ID or SKU.

Product categories and tags

  • Export the full taxonomy tree (categories) or flat list (tags) including descriptions, parent relationships, thumbnails, display type, and term meta.
  • Import categories and tags with parent resolution by name or slug.

Common features

  • CSV column mapping UI for advanced imports + Quick Import for one-click round-trips.
  • Batched processing with configurable batch size — handles tens of thousands of records without timeouts.
  • Import/export history table with per-operation logs, downloadable exported files, and optional auto-delete of old records.
  • CSV delimiter selectable per operation (comma, semicolon, tab, pipe, or custom).
  • Backup-before-import confirmation on every import action.
  • Save and reuse column-mapping templates.

Premium Version Features

  • Background Import: Continue import operations in the background, even after closing the browser window.
  • Bundle Import & Export: Import and export products, orders, customers, coupons, reviews, categories, and tags in a single operation.
  • Meta Fields Support: Support ACF fields and custom meta fields with advanced field mapping.
  • Excel, XML, CSV, and TSV Support: Import and export data using Excel (.xlsx), XML, CSV, and TSV file formats.
  • Google Sheets Integration: Connect Google Sheets and sync data directly from your spreadsheets.
  • Scheduled Import & Export: Schedule imports and exports to run automatically at specified times.
  • FTP, SFTP, and URL Import: Import files directly from FTP, SFTP, and remote URLs.
  • Advanced Filters & Customization: Apply advanced filters and control how duplicate records are handled during import and export.

How to Export WooCommerce Products

Exporting WooCommerce products is essential for anyone migrating stores, backing up a product catalog, making bulk updates, or keeping track of inventory. Since WooCommerce stores support exporting products in CSV format, access to structured data makes analyzing and updating products simpler.

Dazzlebirds Products Import Export for WooCommerce lets you export products with key catalog info such as categories, tags, attributes, variations, pricing, stock information, and images all at once. The advanced export filters let you build a tailored dataset for each export, making product management more organized and efficient for your business needs.

To export, activate the plugin, confirm WooCommerce is installed and active, then go to WC Data Manager → Export in the WordPress admin menu.

How to Import WooCommerce Products

Maintaining an accurate, up-to-date product catalog is essential for running a WooCommerce store. Adding new products, updating existing stock, importing product data from another shop, or restoring product info from a backup is much easier with CSV files.

Dazzlebirds Products Import Export for WooCommerce helps you import products in bulk instead of creating and updating them by hand. Product data such as categories, tags, attributes and variations, pricing, stock details, and images can be imported and mapped to the correct WooCommerce fields to keep the catalog neatly structured.

To import, activate the plugin, confirm WooCommerce is installed and active, then go to WC Data Manager → Import in the WordPress admin menu.

Recommended WP SmartStore Plugins

  • Dazzlebirds Users Import Export for WooCommerce — Easily import, export, and manage WordPress users and WooCommerce customers, including billing details, shipping details, user roles, and customer records. https://wordpress.org/plugins/dazzlebirds-users-import-export-for-woocommerce/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/dazzlebirds-products-import-export-for-woocommerce, or install through the WordPress plugin screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Navigate to WC Data Manager in the WordPress admin menu, then choose the Import or Export tab.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce 5.0 or higher must be installed and active.

What file formats are supported?

CSV for both import and export. The delimiter is selectable (comma is the default).

Is there a limit on the number of records?

No hard limit. Imports and exports run in batches; the batch size is configurable under Settings to balance speed against server resources.

Will importing overwrite my existing products?

Importing a product whose ID or SKU matches an existing record will update that record. You will see a confirmation popup warning you to back up before the import runs.

Can I import orders, customers, or coupons with this plugin?

No. This plugin is focused on products and their taxonomies only. For orders and coupons, install the Dazzlebirds Orders Import Export plugin; for users and customers, install the Dazzlebirds Users Import Export plugin.

Does it handle variable products with variations?

Yes. Variations are exported as their own rows (linked to the parent via SKU) and imported back with attribute, stock, and pricing inheritance preserved.

1.1.0

  • Scope change: order, customer, and coupon import-export have moved to two dedicated companion plugins.
    Existing users will see a one-time admin notice with install buttons for the new plugins:

    • Dazzlebirds Orders Import Export For WooCommerce — orders and coupons
    • Dazzlebirds Users Import Export For WooCommerce — users and customers
      Product, product review, product category, and product tag import-export are unchanged.
  • Cross-promotion tiles in the Import/Export grid let you install or open the companion plugins without leaving the page.
  • Internal: dead module folders and ~3,000 lines of cross-entity code removed from this plugin.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Product import/export with variations, attributes, gallery images, stock, low-stock threshold, and metadata.
  • Product review import/export with verified-purchase flag and approval state.
  • Product category and tag import/export with parent relationships, thumbnails, and term meta.
  • Batched processing with configurable batch size.
  • History tracking with optional auto-delete.
  • Save/reuse import column-mapping templates.
  • Backup-before-import warning popup.
